cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Stay Until I’m Steady
cards.instruction: Keep someone present until you feel steady enough to face what comes next without them.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. Before you leave me in the new flat, count five breaths with me.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That was five. Shall I close the door?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. Not yet. Five more while I look at the empty kitchen instead of you.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll wait here while you put the kettle on.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Stay until it boils. Then I'll try pouring one cup without getting yours out.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 directs breaths before leaving, A3 denies door closure and assigns another count, then A5 sets kettle boil as release threshold before a solo act, making departure permission the steadiness tactic.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 completed five prompts A3 harder kitchen-facing count; B4 kettle support prompts A5 stay through boiling then one cup alone.

relationship.evidence: B2 asks before closing and B4 offers to wait during a concrete task, an active considerate helper.

heightening.evidence: B4 kettle solution causes A5 to choose its natural endpoint as the bridge from supported presence to solitude.

specificity.evidence: A1 new flat and B2 departure establish transition; A3 empty kitchen and A5 second-cup impulse convey difficulty without requiring a separation story.

brevityWit.evidence: A5 one cup instead of automatically two is earned by B4 kettle, with tender specificity and a clear threshold.
